d: The Hockey Hall of Fame 2026 Inductees -- Brian Burke, Patrice Bergeron, Cindy Curley, Carey Price, Pekka Rinne, & Keith Tkachuk -- share their thoughts on joining an illustrious group of men and women prior to the induction on November 9. Watch the 2026 Hockey Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony at 8pm ET on NHL Network (US) & TSN 4, TSN 5 (CA).
